model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents two categorical distributions: the outer ring shows the distribution of “Ambiguity Std” with four categories—Std: 0.0 (dark blue, 49.0%), Std: 0.47 (medium-dark blue, 47.7%), Std: 0.82 (medium blue, 7.0%), and Std: 0.94 (light blue, 5.0%)—while the inner ring displays the distribution of “Max Ambiguity” with three categories—Max: 1 (dark blue, 38.0%), Max: 2 (medium blue, 39.0%), and Max: 3 (light blue, 14.2%). The chart includes two legends: one for the outer ring labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and one for the inner ring labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”, which map the colors to their respective categories. Percentage values are clearly labeled within each segment of both rings, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size from left to right in the outer ring and from top to bottom in the inner ring.
